title: Bram and the Verdict
author: Quentin Sandoval
blurb: Cyrus Winterbourne, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
